title: ‘Michael’: Golden Globes Reject Submission to Compete in Comedy/Musical Categories
summary: The music of “Michael” is bringing some drama. Variety has confirmed that Lionsgate’s bid to have its Michael Jackson biopic compete as a comedy or musical at the Golden Globes has been denied.
